analysis_successful_prompt: Evaluate whether the agent had a successful call with the user. For a successful call, the agent should have a complete conversation with user, finished the task, and have not ran into technical issues, or caused user frustration. Besides, the agent was not blocked by a call screen or encountered voicemail.
analysis_summary_prompt: Write a 1-3 sentence summary of the call based on the call transcript. Should capture the important information and actions taken during the call.
analysis_user_sentiment_prompt: Evaluate user's sentiment, mood and satisfaction level.

post_call_analysis_data.name: outcome
post_call_analysis_data.description: The primary outcome of this sales call. Choose the most accurate outcome.

post_call_analysis_data.name: interest_level
post_call_analysis_data.description: How interested was the lead in Title Voice's call tracking solution?

post_call_analysis_data.name: is_decision_maker
post_call_analysis_data.description: Was the person who answered the phone an owner, manager, or decision maker at the title company?

post_call_analysis_data.name: meeting_booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: Was a meeting, demo, video walkthrough, or callback successfully scheduled during this call?

post_call_analysis_data.name: email_captured
post_call_analysis_data.description: Email address if the lead provided one during the call. Return empty string if none provided.

post_call_analysis_data.name: objections_raised
post_call_analysis_data.description: List all objections or concerns the lead raised (e.g. 'too expensive', 'already have a solution', 'not interested right now'). Return empty string if none.

post_call_analysis_data.name: competitor_mentioned
post_call_analysis_data.description: Names of any competing products or services the lead mentioned (e.g. Ruby Receptionist, Smith.ai, AnswerConnect). Return empty string if none.

post_call_analysis_data.name: current_system
post_call_analysis_data.description: The title production software the lead currently uses (e.g. Qualia, ResWare, SoftPro, RamQuest, Closinglock). Return empty string if not mentioned.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: If the lead requested a callback, the preferred date and time they mentioned. Return empty string if no callback requested.

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_duration_seconds
post_call_analysis_data.description: How long the call lasted in seconds. Use 0 if the call did not connect or was very brief.

post_call_analysis_data.name: tools_fired
post_call_analysis_data.description: Comma-separated list of tool names that were successfully called during this conversation. Example: send_vsl_email,book_callback. Use empty string if no tools were fired.

post_call_analysis_data.name: voicemail_detected
post_call_analysis_data.description: Was a voicemail system or IVR detected during this call? True if the call went to voicemail, false otherwise.

post_call_analysis_data.name: quality_score
post_call_analysis_data.description: Rate script adherence and conversation quality from 1-10. 10 = perfect script following, natural conversation, proper objection handling. 1 = completely off-script, missed key steps. Consider: opener delivery, objection handling, close attempt, banned word avoidance, two-sentence max compliance.

post_call_analysis_data.name: spoke_with
post_call_analysis_data.description: Who did we actually speak with on the call?

post_call_analysis_data.name: objection_primary
post_call_analysis_data.description: The primary objection raised during the call, if any.

post_call_analysis_data.name: recon_opener_quality
post_call_analysis_data.description: How specific was the personalized opener? specific = used real company/name data effectively, generic = used a generic greeting, empty = no personalization attempted.

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_successful
post_call_analysis_data.description: Evaluate whether the agent had a successful call with the user. For a successful call, the agent should have a complete conversation with user, finished the task, and have not ran into technical issues, or caused user frustration. Besides, the agent was not blocked by a call screen or encountered voicemail.

post_call_analysis_data.name: user_sentiment
post_call_analysis_data.description: Evaluate user's sentiment, mood and satisfaction level.

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_summary
post_call_analysis_data.description: Write a 1-3 sentence summary of the call based on the call transcript. Should capture the important information and actions taken during the call.

action.text: Hey {{firstName}}, it's Laura with Title Voice. Quick one — do you know how many calls your office missed yesterday? That number might surprise you. I'll send over a quick email. Talk soon.
